parts:
I’ve got you 👍  
Can you paste the info you want rewritten (or drop a screenshot of it) and tell me the **tone** you want for your boss?

For example:
- Professional + calm  
- Firm but respectful  
- Direct and no-nonsense  
- Polite with boundaries  

Once you send it, I’ll rewrite it clean, clear, and boss-appropriate.

Here are a few clean options. Pick the vibe you want, or I can tweak it further.

**Professional, calm**
> Good morning. We had to leave the house last night after a tree branch fell on the roof and we lost power and heat. Out of caution, we relocated since another large tree was leaning over the master bedroom. The boys, TJ, the animals, and I are all safe and warm at his house. The damage appears minimal, but we didn’t want to take any risks.

**Short and straightforward**
> Good morning. A tree branch fell on our roof and we lost power and heat, so we temporarily left the house for safety. Everyone is safe and warm, and the damage looks minimal.

**Reassuring and clear**
> Good morning. Due to a tree branch falling on the roof and no power or heat, we made the decision to leave the house for safety, especially with another large tree leaning over the bedroom. Everyone is safe and warm now. The initial damage looks minor.

If you want it more casual or more formal, say the word and I’ll adjust it.

Here’s a smoother, more natural version that still covers everything clearly and calmly:

> We had to leave my house last night after a sizable tree branch fell on the roof. We lost power around 10 a.m. yesterday and it’s still out. With no heat and another large tree leaning over the master bedroom, we decided to relocate out of caution. We were also concerned about the cold and food going bad. The boys, Tommy, the animals, all of our food, and I are safe and warm at his house. The damage appears minimal, but we didn’t want to take any risks.

If you want it a touch shorter or even more polished for work, I can tighten it one more notch.

Rewrite this to sound more flowy : We had to leave my house last night after a sizable tree branch fell on the roof. We also lost power at around 10am yesterday and it's still out. Due to no heat and out of caution, we relocated since another large tree was leaning over the master bedroom and we were cold and food was going to go bad. So the boys, Tommy the animals, all of our food and I are all safe and warm at his house. The damage appears minimal, but we didn’t want to take any risks.

GM. We had to leave our house a  tree branch fell on roof and there was still no power and no heat, so we left. The two boys, me and TJ, the animals and all of the fridge stuff are at his house safe and warm. The tree didn't do too much damage but there was another huge one leaning over the master bedroom and we didn't want to risk sleeping under that if it fell.
Rewrite this info and make it a response to my boss
